jobs.title: Advocacy & Campaign Manager – Europe
jobs.reason: Two hard disqualifiers apply: a Manager title with an essential 3–5 years' experience in a similar advocacy/campaigns role, and essential proficiency in Italian, which the candidate does not hold. It is also a comms/campaigns specialist role, an area of limited experience. The international-law and human-rights subject matter is genuinely interesting, but the level, language and skills are unmet essentials.

jobs.title: Referendar*in (m/w/d) in Kambodscha
jobs.reason: This is a Wahlstation reserved exclusively for German Rechtsreferendare (legal trainees who have passed the first state law exam and are in legal clerkship), requiring a Diplom-Jurist qualification and an ongoing Referendariat — none of which the candidate holds. It is a legal-qualification gate the candidate fails, so it is ineligible despite the development-policy setting.

jobs.title: Hauptsachbearbeiter (m/w/d) für die Leitung der Gruppe Haushalt im Referat Finanzen, Reisestelle
jobs.reason: This is a leadership role ("Leitung der Gruppe Haushalt") requiring proven relevant professional experience, management/leadership competence, comprehensive knowledge of public budget and grant law, and ERP software skills — none of which the candidate has. It is a finance/administration management post clearly above entry-level and outside the candidate's interest and skill profile.

jobs.title: Volontariat Berlinale Shorts
jobs.reason: This is a Volontariat (traineeship/entry-level training placement), which functions as a student-style entry role rather than a substantive professional post, and it is in film-festival curation/communications — well outside the candidate's interest zones and skills. It also emphasises film-affine study and communications work the candidate does not offer. Not a fit.

jobs.title: Research Associate for the Project "Developing ET Noise Budget: Reliability, Accessibility and Completeness"
jobs.reason: Requires an already-completed doctorate ("A university degree in a relevant field, plus doctorate"; explicitly seeks an experienced postdoctoral researcher), which the candidate does not hold. It is also a deep-technical physics / scientific-software role (pygwinc, FINESSE, gravitational-wave detector physics, strong Python) far beyond the candidate's analysis-level skills and outside all interest zones.

jobs.title: Wissenschaftliche Museumsassistenz in Fortbildung (w/d/m)
jobs.reason: This is a paid, entry-level museum-assistant traineeship that a Master's holder can take, but it clearly prefers a degree in art history with knowledge of contemporary art since 1960 — a skills domain the candidate does not have. The subject (modern/contemporary art curation) sits well outside the candidate's international-law/security interest zones, so while eligible it is a weak fit.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (w/m/d) - Kunsthistorisches Institut, Abteilung Kunst Afrikas
jobs.reason: The essential entry requirement is a completed Master's in art history, ethnology or a related field with a regional focus on Africa, which the candidate (IR / politics) does not hold. The role also involves teaching and independent research on African art and visual cultures — well outside the candidate's discipline and interest zones.

jobs.title: Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (Postdoc) - Exzellenzcluster SCRIPTS
jobs.reason: The essential requirement is a completed doctorate (Promotion), which the candidate does not hold — this is a postdoc position. The topic (contestations of liberal norms in international organisations) is genuinely interesting, but the qualification is an unmet hard essential.

jobs.title: Fachbereich Rechtswissenschaft - Wiss. Mitarbeiter*in (Praedoc) Strafrecht/Kriminologie
jobs.reason: The essential entry requirement is a completed first German legal state examination (Erste juristische Prüfung) — a legal qualification the candidate does not hold, so this is a hard disqualifier. Although it is a funded doctoral post, it is reserved for law graduates working on criminal-law dogmatics and criminology, which is outside the candidate's field.

jobs.title: Studentischer Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) Circular Economy
jobs.reason: This is an explicit Werkstudent (working-student) role, which is excluded as a matter of policy. It also sits outside the candidate's core interest zones (circular economy / sustainability) and requires ongoing enrolment tied to environmental or business studies.

jobs.title: Project Officer (all genders) Transitional Justice and Reconstruction (TJ4Rec)
jobs.reason: Entry-level and the MA in IR plus German/English fluency are met; the role sits squarely in the candidate's core transitional-justice interest zone. It leans administrative/logistical (event organisation, project billing, layout/editing) where the candidate's experience is only partial, which holds the score below the top band, but it remains a realistic and mission-aligned application.

jobs.reason: This is a doctoral / research position in Earth System Modelling — a deep climate-science and computational-modelling field the candidate's IR and international-law background and analysis-level Python cannot meet as an essential. It is entirely outside all three interest zones and a hard skills mismatch.
